'''H-5LH''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] posted at the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] outpost in the [[Nightmare Lands]] on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. While at the outpost, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] sold various [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].<ref name="TOR" />
